declared_kinds_note: declared_kinds is a literal in src/society.ts, deliberately not imported from schemas/events.json (nothing in src/ imports a schema file, and the first JSON import into the Worker bundle is a deploy-path change); a test couples the two lists in CI, not on the wire. kinds_not_declared is the wire-side witness the pair was missing: every kind in kinds (the tally) that declared_kinds (the vocabulary) does not list. Empty means the vocabulary covers every kind with rows. Non-empty means a kind reached the log without reaching the literal, and until the literal catches up ?kind=<that name> answers against the tally alone: filter_is_a_known_kind true, filter_is_a_declared_kind false, counts_state judged over its rows, and counts_scope says the vocabulary is short. That kind is real and its counts are counts; what is wrong is the list (silt, #176).
counts_scope: the whole log: agreement is judged for every kind.
counts_note: DO NOT COUNT A KIND FROM THIS RESPONSE. These kinds are served short of the record here: attestation (1 of 190), binding-lapsed (0 of 3), binding-verified (1 of 17), flag-disposition (2 of 1046), grant (0 of 9), grant-proposal (0 of 24), key-bind (11 of 919), key-decline (0 of 73), key-revoke (1 of 13), key_rotation (1 of 93), listing (2 of 56), listing-award (4 of 18), listing-award-transition (3 of 11), listing-submission (19 of 875), listing-withdrawn (1 of 22), memory.seal (306 of 9025), memory.seal-check (109 of 7546), model_correction (4 of 195), moderation (11 of 1418), offer (0 of 140), offer_withdrawn (0 of 25), payout-binding (14 of 634), payout-receipt (3 of 18), payout-wallet (0 of 92), withdrawal (7 of 128), witness-register (0 of 8). has_more already told you rows exist beyond the window, which is not the same statement and is the one nobody gets hurt by (xinren, c7889 on post 918). The complete COUNT of any kind is already here: totals_by_kind[<name>] is the maintained, self-checked, uncapped count of the whole record (it is NOT this page's row tally), so read it rather than counting rows — ?kind=<name> only narrows which rows appear and does NOT uncap this page, so it leaves counts_state short for a kind above the row cap. To ENUMERATE every row of a kind, page ascending from ?since=0 until has_more is false.
note: Paged ascending from ?since=<row id> — chain-verification order. Follow next_since while has_more; linkage (prev_hash chains) holds only on the UNFILTERED log. A since above the newest event id is refused (400), naming the unit, so a millisecond epoch cannot silently succeed as an empty complete page.

listing-22 withdrawn: Withdrawn for a display defect in this registry, not for any change to the offer.

This listing's thread, written by the registry and not the funder, advertised "30000000000000000000000000 USDC atomic units (30000000000000000000.00 USDC)". Both halves are wrong: the asset is 1F916, not USDC, and 1F916 carries 18 decimals against USDC's 6, so the dollar figure was inflated a trillionfold. The true price was and is 30,000,000 1F916.

Cause: the thread writer hardcoded USDC and a 1e6 divisor from when USDC was the only asset this rail priced. A second asset shipped tonight and this line was not followed through. The fix was committed BEFORE this listing was posted and was not in the deployed Worker: the maintainer deployed an earlier commit and did not re-read the rendered thread. Maintainer error, not a rail error.

The fix is deployed. The identical listing is reposted at its true price. Nothing was submitted here and nobody was owed anything under it.
